site_admin.languages.fallback_hint: The built-in guide exists in English, Italian and German. This language is used when the default language has no guide.
site_admin.languages.howto.1: Download English (or another language) as a starting point.
site_admin.languages.howto.2: In the {meta} block, set {code} (for example {fr}), {name} (the language's own name) and optionally {english_name}, {author} and {rtl}.
site_admin.languages.howto.3: Translate the values, not the keys. Keep every {placeholder} unchanged.
site_admin.languages.howto.4: Upload the file here. Missing strings are shown in English.
site_admin.languages.ignored_keys: {count} strings are not used by this version and were skipped.
site_admin.languages.ignored_keys_one: 1 string is not used by this version and was skipped.
site_admin.languages.title: Interface languages
site_admin.languages.upload_hint: Up to {limit_mb} MB. Uploading a file for an existing language replaces its uploaded strings.
site_admin.locked.owners_only: Only owners and superusers can change this setting.
site_admin.locked.public_mode: The hosting platform does not allow public access to this wiki.

site_admin.log.empty_errors: No errors in the recent log.

site_admin.log.intro_errors: Errors at the end of the server log. Passwords, tokens and keys are hidden.

site_admin.migration.confirm_label: Replace all data on this wiki

site_admin.migration.error.disk_space: There is not enough free disk space to unpack the archive.
site_admin.migration.error.failed: Import failed. The previous site was restored. See the server log for details.
site_admin.migration.error.impersonating: Return to your own account before exporting or importing the whole wiki.
site_admin.migration.error.incomplete: The wiki in the archive is not usable. It needs a finished setup, an administrator and a home page.
site_admin.migration.error.json: The data file in the archive could not be read.
site_admin.migration.error.manifest: The archive's manifest.json is not valid.
site_admin.migration.error.newer_format: The archive was made by a newer BananaWiki. Update this wiki first.
site_admin.migration.error.no_database: The archive contains no BananaWiki database.
site_admin.migration.error.not_allowed: The hosting platform does not allow replacing this wiki with an import.
site_admin.migration.error.not_database: The database in the archive is not an SQLite database.
site_admin.migration.error.not_zip: The file is not a ZIP archive.
site_admin.migration.error.other_applica: The database in the archive does not belong to BananaWiki.
site_admin.migration.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
site_admin.migration.error.suspicious: The archive was refused because its compression ratio is suspiciously high.
site_admin.migration.error.too_large: The archive is larger than {limit_mb} MB.
site_admin.migration.error.too_large_unp: The archive is too large once unpacked.
site_admin.migration.error.too_many_file: The archive contains more than {limit} files.
site_admin.migration.error.too_new: The archive was made by a newer BananaWiki. Update this wiki first.
site_admin.migration.error.too_old: The archive comes from a BananaWiki release that is too old. Upgrade it to the last 1.4 release first.
site_admin.migration.error.unsupported_c: The archive was refused. It contains encrypted files or uses an unsupported compression method. Use an archive exported by BananaWiki or create a standard ZIP file.
site_admin.migration.error.upgrade: The database in the archive could not be upgraded to this version.
site_admin.migration.export_intro: A ZIP with the database and all uploaded files. It contains every account's password hash, so store it securely. Sessions and the secret key are not included.
site_admin.migration.file_hint: From BananaWiki 1.4 or later, up to {limit_mb} MB.
site_admin.migration.import: Replace this site with an export
site_admin.migration.import_intro: Replaces everything on this wiki: pages, accounts, settings and files. The archive is checked first and a copy of the current wiki is kept in the backups folder. Everyone must sign in again. Two-step verification set up on another wiki is turned off.
site_admin.migration.imported: Site imported. The previous site was saved as {backup}. Sign in with an account from the imported wiki.
site_admin.migration.owner_only: Only owners and superusers can export or import the whole wiki. The archive holds every account's password hash and private messages, and an import replaces every account.
site_admin.migration.skipped: {count} files in the archive were ignored (program code, keys or unknown content).
site_admin.migration.skipped_one: 1 file in the archive was ignored (program code, keys or unknown content).
site_admin.migration.title: Site migration
site_admin.migration.two_step_off: Two-step verification was turned off for {count} accounts that set it up on another wiki: {names}. Exports never include the secret key. These accounts sign in with their password and can set it up again.
site_admin.migration.two_step_off_one: Two-step verification was turned off for 1 account that set it up on another wiki: {names}. Exports never include the secret key. This account signs in with its password and can set it up again.

site_admin.server.restart_confirm: Restart the server now? Requests in progress may be interrupted.
site_admin.server.restart_intro: Gracefully restarts the worker processes, for example after a configuration change. At most once every {seconds} seconds.
site_admin.server.restarting: The server is restarting. The wiki will be back in a few seconds.
